title: 2.1.3 release readiness: the MOSS release (MOSS-Image, Multi-angle, Singularity H3)
description: The MOSS release = 2.1.3 (Fabio, 2026-10-25). Members so far: MOSS-Image and its follow-ups (MPI-1243, MPI-1245, MPI-1249, MPI-1253: done, waiting on this release); Multi-angle Flow (MPI-1039, ships with MOSS per Fabio 2026-10-24); MPI-1284: MiniMax H3 Reference switches its base model to Singularity H3 v2 (name unchanged) and both H3 models gain sol-attn. NOTHING is deprecated: MiniMax H3 (fl2va) stays, because Singularity is not an image-to-video model (Fabio, MPI-1135 Phase 1e). Licence check first. Bench evidence: MPI-1135 validation.md. Candidate ride-alongs, not yet assigned to a release: MPI-1283 (sections in H3 ref prompts), MPI-1285 (Fast Motion, H3 Reference only). LTX 2.5 is NOT in this release (MPI-1267). Version number and the cut stay Fabio's call.
